label: Memory
words: winfer's own resident memory, sampled every 5 seconds into the log. A steady climb before a crash points at a leak; the timeline in the export shows it.

label: Logs
words: winfer.log keeps the app log (rotated at 5 MB); crash.log holds panics with backtraces. Both live in the folder below.

label: Latest crash
words: The end of crash.log. Full backtraces are in the file and in the export.
